note: The six content pages, as structured blocks, so adding a paragraph to the returns policy is a JSON edit and not a code change. Block types: p, h2, ul, fromShop, contactCard, shippingTable, deliveryRange, returnWindow. A `fromShop` block interpolates a value straight out of shop.json, which is what stops a policy page and the cart arithmetic disagreeing -- data.pl fails on a path that does not resolve, turning 'the policy says 99 but we charge 149' from an embarrassment into a check failure. ⚠️ THE POLICY COPY BELOW IS NOT LEGAL ADVICE AND HAS NOT BEEN REVIEWED. The returns address, the GSTIN and the courier are still blank in shop.json, and the pages say so out loud rather than inventing them -- a returns policy naming an address that does not exist is worse than one that admits it is being set up.

blocks.v: For seventeen years this floor has cut, stitched and finished clothes that left here with somebody else name on the collar. The cloth was ours to choose, the pattern masters were ours, the finishing line was ours. The label never was.

That is a good business and it is also a fragile one. A brand can move its order to another unit in a season, and everything we know how to do goes with it. So this is the same floor, the same people and the same cloth, under our own name, sold directly to the person who will wear it.
What we make

Mens shirts, and womenswear across kurtis and dresses, with more of both to come. Everything is graded S to XXL on the same blocks we grade for export, which is why the size chart on every product page is a real grading and not a guess. Most clothing returns are a fit problem, and a fit problem is usually a chart problem.
What that buys you
No distributor, no retailer margin, no minimum order. The price here is the price of making the garment plus what it costs to send it to you, and nothing in between.
What we are still building

This website is new and we would rather tell you what it does not do yet than let you find out. It does not take payment: the UPI code shown at checkout is a demonstration one and no money can move through it. Order tracking exists but lives only in the browser you ordered from. Both are being fixed, in that order.
The brand name, the prices and the contact details on this site are placeholders while it is being built. Nothing here is a real offer yet.
We answer during working hours and usually the same day. If your message is about an order, quote the order code -- it is the fastest way to the right person.
Before you write

v: Sizes: the chart on each product page is body measurements in inches. If you are between two sizes, take the larger.
Delivery: five to ten working days across India, free. The estimate on your order page is the one we committed to when you placed it.
Returns: seven days from the day it reaches you, free.

What this website stores, and where

Today, almost everything stays on your own device. Your bag, your wishlist, your address and your orders are kept in this browser and nowhere else. Clearing your browser data erases all of it, and there is no copy for us to restore.

That is a limitation, not a privacy promise, and it is changing: an order you are waiting ten days for has to be visible from a second phone. When accounts arrive, this page will be rewritten before the feature ships, not after.
What reaches us
Only what you send us. If you message or email us, we have that message. We do not have your bag, your browsing or anything you typed and did not send.
What we do not do

v: No advertising or analytics trackers of any kind.
No cookies set by this site.
No selling, sharing or renting of anything about you to anybody.

blocks.v: Fonts

The typefaces load from Google Fonts, which means Google receives your IP address and the name of the font file when a page loads. It is the one third party this site contacts. Hosting the files ourselves would remove it, and is on the list.
Your rights
Write to us to ask what we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted. Since almost nothing leaves your device today, the answer is usually short.
The clock starts the day the parcel reaches you, not the day you ordered. A parcel that takes ten days to arrive would otherwise have its return window close before it landed.
What we take back

v: The wrong size, for any reason, including that you simply guessed wrong.
A garment that does not match what the page showed.
A fault in the cloth or the stitching, whenever you find it -- a seam that fails in month two is our problem, not a return.

blocks.v: What we cannot take back

v: Anything without its tags still attached.
Anything bought as a final-sale item, which is marked as such on the product page before you buy it.

blocks.v: How it works
Tell us from your order page. We arrange the pickup; you do not book a courier and you do not pay for one. Keep the garment and its tags together until it is collected.
Refunds

To the original payment method, once the garment is back with us and has been checked. For a cash-on-delivery order we will ask for bank details, because there is no payment method to send it back to.
Exchanges
For a different size, yes, subject to stock. Tell us the size you want when you raise the return and we will hold it.
Still being settled

The pickup address and the courier that collects from you are not finalised. Until they are, treat the promise above as what we intend rather than what is in place, and write to us before sending anything back.
Charges
How long it takes

You are given two dates, not one, and they are fixed at the moment you place the order. They do not move afterwards. A single promised date on a parcel travelling across India is a date that gets missed; a range we can keep is worth more than a precise one we cannot.
Where we deliver
Anywhere in India. We do not ship internationally. Remote PIN codes can take a few days longer than the upper end of the estimate, and we will tell you if yours is one.
Tracking

Your order page shows where it is. Today that page lives in the browser you ordered from, so it will not open on a different phone -- which is the first thing being fixed. A courier tracking number will appear on it once a courier is appointed.
Who carries it
Not yet appointed. The five-to-ten-day estimate above is what we are planning around, not a quoted service level, and this page will name the courier once there is one.
What an order on this site is
Placing an order here creates a record and tells us what you want. It is an offer to buy, which becomes a contract when we confirm it. Until then nothing is committed on either side.
We may decline an order, most often because something sold out between your tap and our reading it. If that happens we tell you, and anything paid comes straight back.
Prices

In Indian Rupees and inclusive of GST where it applies. We may change a price at any time, but never on an order already confirmed. Where a size costs more than the base price, the product page says so before you add it to the bag.
Payment

This website does not take payment. A UPI code is shown so you can pay from your own app, and cash on delivery is offered. The code currently on the site is a demonstration one that no payment app can resolve, and the checkout says so.
Sizes and colour

Measurements are given as a grading and a garment is allowed to vary from it by about half an inch. Colour on a screen is not colour in a room; dyed cotton in particular varies between batches, and a small difference is the material behaving normally rather than a fault.
Product images

The artwork on this site is generated, not photographed, and it shows the kind of print and the cut rather than the exact garment you will receive. It is labelled as such on every product page. Photographs will replace it.
Intellectual property
The text, artwork and design of this site belong to us. The patterns and crafts they draw on belong to the people who have made them for centuries and to nobody in particular.
Governing law
The laws of India, and the courts with jurisdiction where we are registered. Our registered address and GSTIN are on the Contact page; while they are blank, this site is not trading.
